mechanism: Polyethylene glycol (osmotic laxative) may reduce piperacillin-tazobactam absorption through accelerated gastrointestinal transit and increased fluid volume in the bowel lumen.
action: Separate administration by at least 2 hours; preferably administer piperacillin-tazobactam before bowel preparation or after PEG-induced diarrhea resolves. Monitor clinical response if used concurrently.
